text:
elaine: FYI ran PTQ bringup for rerank-v5 on holdout-E. Seeing odd per-query flips that look like tiny logit rounding + ANN ordering interacting. Leaving a short summary.

peter: Numbers?

elaine: fp16 NDCG@10=0.452, ptq NDCG@10=0.429 avg over 4 seeds. Stdev for ptq ~0.014 vs fp16 ~0.003. MRR drops ~0.02.

omar: Any signal whether retrieval changes or just score reshuffles?

elainE: (typo) elaine: quick repro shows: with fixed topk snapshot variance collapses to stdev=0.005. So retrieval nondet is dominant, but ptq increases sensitivity so small retrieval deltas hurt more.

vivian: Can you dump a couple of diffs and a minimal script? Also we should capture per-query float16 logits for 200 high-variance queries.

elaine: Example query q_900: 
```
fp16 top3: [d1(3.21), d2(2.98), d3(2.95)]
ptq seedA: [d1(3.21), d3(2.975), d4(2.96)]
ptq seedB: [d1(3.21), d2(2.981), d3(2.95)]
```

deploy-bot: Snapshot written to s3://redwood-eval/holdoutE/snapshots/snap-1809876543. Deterministic-retrieval flag is available in harness.

peter: Actionable plan: 1) run fingerprint sweep (sha1 of concatenated id:score) across 5 seeds with snapshot and collect mean Jaccard; 2) store float16 logits for top 200 queries; 3) run layer-ablations to see which partition causes largest score jitter; 4) add an onboarding config that uses snapshot+fingerprinting by default.

ovar: (omar) I'll add the fingerprinting patch to the harness and push a small dashboard.

vivian: I'll own the layer ablations and kernel rescale checks. If softmax clamp / rescale constants differ between int8 kernel and fp16 we can try adjusting calibration to preserve score gaps.

elaine: I'll upload artifacts and a tiny repro script to the run folder and follow up with a PR. Tagging @peter @omar @vivian

peter: Thanks ":thumbsup:" ping when artifacts live.
